title: United States Department of the Treasury Announces Key Nomination
summary: Secretary Scott Bessent announced President Trump's intent to nominate G. Hunter McMaster II as Assistant Secretary for Financial Markets. McMaster currently serves as Counselor to the Secretary and has been performing the delegable duties of the position since July 2025. His prior experience includes Head of Trading at Key Square Group and positions at Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs focusing on foreign exchange and interest rate markets.
